title: LoRa L2: preserve queue-destroy retry teardown provenance
description: Round-3 correctness review found normal STOPPED deinit maps tx_queue_destroy failure to generic LORA_ABORTED. Retrying deinit then takes the abort-only RX join path even if RX was never started or was already joined by stop(), potentially failing before the queue destroy retry. Add a distinct queue-destroy-failed lifecycle state or equivalent provenance so retry skips already-completed worker teardown and safely retries only remaining cleanup.
acceptance_criteria: Queue-destroy failure during normal teardown remains non-reinitializable but a subsequent deinit retries destruction without abort-only RX-thread assumptions; abort-origin teardown remains correct; successful retry reaches UNINIT; lifecycle tests/builds pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by host sanitizer suite plus review cycle; superseding round-4 findings are tracked separately
